result.instructions: Tools for TalentLyft, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which jobs are open right now, and how many candidates applied to each?"; "Show me the candidates who applied to the sales manager job this week."; "Move Anna Berg's application for the support role to the interview stage.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TalentLyft data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run talentlyft_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run talentlyft_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run talentlyft_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. talentlyft_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: talentlyft_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs in the TalentLyft account, filterable by status and text. Use the returned job ids with talentlyft_get_job and talentlyft_list_job_stages. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/jobs.

status.description: Job status filter, as TalentLyft defines it (for example open or closed).

contains.description: Text to search in job titles.

sort.description: Sort field, as TalentLyft defines it.

language_code.description: Language code for job texts (for example en).

include_stages.description: Include the hiring stages of each job.

tools.name: talentlyft_get_job
tools.title: Get a job
tools.description: Get one job by id, including its details. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/jobs/{id}.

language_code.description: Language code for job texts (for example en).

tools.name: talentlyft_list_job_stages
tools.title: List job stages
tools.description: List the hiring stages of one job, in order. Use a stage id with talentlyft_move_application_to_stage. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/jobs/{id}/stages.

tools.name: talentlyft_list_candidates
tools.title: List candidates
tools.description: List candidates, optionally only those who applied for some jobs or were created after a date. Returns candidate ids for talentlyft_get_candidate. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/candidates.

job_ids.description: Comma-separated job ids to filter the candidates by.

created_after.description: Only candidates created after this ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: talentlyft_get_candidate
tools.title: Get a candidate
tools.description: Get one candidate by id, with contact details, tags, and the list of applications (each with its job and stage). TalentLyft API: GET /v2/candidates/{id}.

tools.name: talentlyft_list_candidate_activities
tools.title: List candidate activities
tools.description: List the timeline activities of one candidate (notes, stage moves, and other events). TalentLyft API: GET /v2/candidates/{id}/activities.

tools.name: talentlyft_get_application
tools.title: Get a candidate application
tools.description: Get one application of a candidate (one candidate for one job), with its stage, evaluation and answers. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/candidates/{id}/applications/{applicationId}.

application_id.description: The application id (from the candidate's Applications list).

tools.name: talentlyft_list_pipelines
tools.title: List pipelines
tools.description: List the hiring pipelines (the stage sets that jobs use). TalentLyft API: GET /v2/pipelines.

contains.description: Text to search in pipeline names.

type.description: Pipeline type filter, as TalentLyft defines it.

tools.name: talentlyft_list_departments
tools.title: List departments
tools.description: List the departments of the company. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/departments.

tools.name: talentlyft_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List the team members of the company (recruiters and managers), with their ids. Use a member id as the author of a note or a stage move. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/members.

tools.name: talentlyft_list_rejection_reasons
tools.title: List rejection reasons
tools.description: List the rejection reasons that the company uses when it disqualifies a candidate. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/rejection_reasons.

contains.description: Text to search in reason names.

tools.name: talentlyft_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List calendar events (interviews and meetings), filterable by date range, job, candidate, or member. TalentLyft API: GET /v2/events.

range_start.description: Only events from this ISO 8601 date-time.

range_end.description: Only events until this ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: talentlyft_add_candidate_note
tools.title: Add a note to a candidate
tools.description: Write a note on a candidate's timeline, as the given team member. The note is visible to the team. Each call creates a new note. TalentLyft API: POST /v2/candidates/{id}/note.

member_id.description: Member id of the author (from talentlyft_list_members).

application_id.description: Attach the note to one application of the candidate.

annotations.title: Add a note to a candidate

tools.name: talentlyft_move_application_to_stage
tools.title: Move an application to a stage
tools.description: Move one candidate application to another hiring stage of its job, as the given team member. TalentLyft may send the candidate or the team the usual stage notifications. TalentLyft API: POST /v2/candidates/{id}/applications/{applicationId}/move_to_stage/{stageId}.

member_id.description: Member id of the person who moves the candidate (from talentlyft_list_members).

annotations.title: Move an application to a stage
